Yay, there's an official ruling on hero destruction/flipping over on BGG:

Essentially, consider the Hero Incapacitation rules to read: "If a hero is destroyed, by either being reduced to 0 HP or otherwise, then flip their Hero Character Card and remove all their cards from the game."

I could have gone either way with this ruling, based on the letter of the law, but given the option between, "Look, you just die when you reach 0 HP, regardless of indestructibility," and "Certain specific situations can make you go into negative HP temporarily and perhaps recover," the second is obviously more awesome and fun. So! If the above wording is the official ruling, (which it is), then that makes both Fixed Point from the Time Cataclysm environment AND Unforgiving Wasteland from The Final Wasteland environment much more exciting cards.

Enjoy!

http://www.boardgamegeek.com/article/11746368#11746368

Also: this means effects that would destroy hero character cards outright cause them to flip properly without any wonky exceptions.

Almost. Heroes no longer "flip at 0hp" normally. When they would be destroyed, they flip instead. One of the ways that targets are destroyed is when they are reduced to 0 or fewer HP. UW says that whenever a target would be destroyed by damage dealt by an environment card, remove that card from the game instead. This means that hero character cards are removed from the game instead of flipped if killed by an environment card with UW out.

It looks to me that, based on this change and the way it functions, The Operative and Ennead character cards would not be removed from the game. The instructions to flip them instead of destroying them are on cards that started the game in play, so their effects will take place before UW. As much as I want it to work, it just doesn't unless Christopher wants to make another erratum.

The upshot is hero character cards CAN be removed from the game, while villain character cards that flip when they would be destroyed (such as the Ennead) CAN NOT.
